about: A modular house for year-round living

A modular house is suitable for year-round living if the walls, floor and roof are insulated to the design and the heating is sized for winter. Modules are assembled in the factory, so weather affects quality less, and there is much less work on site than with conventional construction.

The limitation is the size of a module that can be transported by road, so the layout is assembled from several blocks. We design the house to these dimensions and solve large spans and double-height spaces in the design in advance.

The price of a turnkey modular house depends on what it includes: foundation, delivery, installation, utility connections. We list these as separate lines in the estimate so that “turnkey” means the same for us and for you.

The total depends most on the area and number of modules, delivery distance, foundation type, heating system and finish level. The benchmark for a turnkey house is from $1,100 per m². Modular cabins are also used at resorts, in glamping and as guest houses; for several cabins, start with a site master plan. Payment 50/50, 50/30/20, 50/40/10 or several instalments, starting with a 10% deposit; photo reports every 1–2 weeks.

faq: How much does a turnkey modular house cost?
From $1,100 per m². The exact price depends on area, number of modules, delivery, foundation and finishes and is fixed in the estimate.
Is the foundation included in the price?
We price the foundation as a separate estimate line for the soil of your plot, so its cost is visible at once, with no extras after installation.
Can you live in a modular house in winter?
Yes, if the modules are insulated to the design and the heating is sized for winter. We build this into the design.
Are delivery and utility connections included?
Delivery and installation of modules are included in the estimate; connection to external utilities, a well and a septic tank are priced separately, as they depend on the plot.
12 months on completed works; installation is carried out by our own salaried team.
